run.description: Will this delivery breach its SLA? (scored at dispatch)

elasticities.note: Late-rate response measured from the dataset: the gap between the top and bottom congestion quartiles, and between adverse and clear weather.

recommendations.title: Adopt the optimised inventory optimisation plan
recommendations.evidence: eoq_analytic reached 9,378,791 against a baseline of 10,454,887 (10.29% better).
recommendations.action: Roll the solver output into the daily planning cycle.

recommendations.title: Consolidate routes running under 40% capacity
recommendations.evidence: 77% of routes carry under 40% of vehicle capacity (median 7%).
recommendations.action: Raise the minimum load threshold before a route is dispatched.

recommendations.title: Plan replacement for 219 vehicles over 8 years old
recommendations.evidence: 219 of 500 vehicles (44%) are past 8 years, where unplanned failure rates climb sharply.
recommendations.action: Stage replacements against the maintenance-cost curve.

recommendations.title: Raise safety stock on the SKUs driving stockouts
recommendations.evidence: 1.36% of warehouse-SKU snapshots are stocked out, blocking fulfilment at those sites.
recommendations.action: Apply the EOQ policy from the optimization module.

recommendations.title: Add weather-aware buffers to the SLA promise
recommendations.evidence: Adverse weather lifts the late rate by 2.0pp across 7,236 deliveries.
recommendations.action: Extend promised windows automatically when severity crosses a threshold.

recommendations.title: Adopt the optimised fleet allocation plan
recommendations.evidence: ortools_cp_sat reached 3,640 against a baseline of 12,519 (70.92% better).
recommendations.action: Roll the solver output into the daily planning cycle.

recommendations.title: Target the 10 worst-performing delivery zones
recommendations.evidence: These zones run a 23.7% late rate against a network average of 11.3%, over 760 deliveries.
recommendations.action: Re-cut the zone boundaries and add a dedicated slot for these areas.

recommendations.title: Adopt the optimised driver scheduling plan
recommendations.evidence: ortools_cp_sat reached 6,028 against a baseline of 8,782 (31.36% better).
recommendations.action: Roll the solver output into the daily planning cycle.

recommendations.title: Focus SLA policy on the drivers the model actually uses
recommendations.evidence: SHAP attributes most of the late-delivery prediction to sla_hours, lead_time_hours, planned_duration_min - sla_hours alone accounts for 39% of total attribution.
recommendations.action: Tune promised windows against these levers before adding capacity.
